source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once this transport finishes shooting in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), pick an enemy unit it hit. Friendly units that have [disembarked](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking) from it during this turn can reroll their **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** against the chosen enemy.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.trigger: this transport has shot in your Shooting phase

effect.recipient: friendly units that disembarked from this transport this turn
